# World drawing: drawing

`cinnabar:world-draw/drawing@0.2.0`

Owner and connection scoped resources. Every mutation is a callback transaction.

**Grants:** `world_draw` for mutations; `entity_observe` for observation, `entity_highlight` for attachment, `render_through_walls` for elevated depth and `render_material` for custom materials. capabilities reports granted bits.

## Types

<a id="type-permissions"></a>

### `permissions`

Independent authority bits; advertised support does not itself grant another capability.

```wit

    world-draw,
    entity-observe,
    entity-highlight,
    render-through-walls,
    render-material,
    render-post,
}
```

<a id="type-block-cell"></a>

### `block-cell`

Light channels are 0..15. Missing light uses sky 15 and block 0.

```wit

    palette: u32,
    sky-light: option<u8>,
    block-light: option<u8>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `palette` | `u32` |  |
| `sky-light` | `option<u8>` |  |
| `block-light` | `option<u8>` |  |

<a id="type-block-cell-word"></a>

### `block-cell-word`

Low 16 bits select the palette; the next byte is sky light, the high byte block light.
Each light byte is 0..15, or 255 for absent. SDK pack-block-cell builds these words.

```wit
type block-cell-word = u32;
```

<a id="type-block-grid"></a>

### `block-grid`

Dense packed cells in x,z,y order (y changes fastest). Outside cells are air.
Plain words upload without a guest-side record conversion loop.

```wit
record block-grid {
    size: tuple<u32, u32, u32>,
    palette: list<block-state>,
    cells: list<block-cell-word>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `tuple<u32, u32, u32>` |  |
| `palette` | `list<block-state>` |  |
| `cells` | `list<block-cell-word>` |  |

Types: [`block-cell-word`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-block-cell-word), [`block-state`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-block-state).

## Functions

<a id="create-material"></a>

### `create-material`

```wit
create-material: func(source: string) -> result<handle, draw-error>;
```

Custom procedural fragments use the render-material grant, without textures or depth output.
Successful creation means source validation succeeded; native compilation may still fail.

Types: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle).

<a id="capabilities"></a>

### `capabilities`

```wit
capabilities: func() -> permissions;
```

Reports this instance's independently granted drawing permissions, including when drawing is denied.

Types: [`permissions`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-permissions).

<a id="observe-entities"></a>

### `observe-entities`

```wit
observe-entities: func() -> result<list<observed-entity>, draw-error>;
```

Types: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`observed-entity`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-observed-entity).
